tagline: A hybrid multicloud computing leader, offering organizations a unified software platform for running applications and AI and managing data anywhere.
hero_kpi_rationale: Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) is the primary driver of growth and valuation at Nutanix, reflecting the adoption of its subscription-based software platform model, particularly in AI-driven hybrid and multicloud deployments.

kpis.name: Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR)
kpis.explanation: Annual recurring revenue generated from software subscriptions and related services.
kpis.description: ARR shows steady growth, increasing from $1.56B in 2023 to $2.22B in 2025, reflecting customer retention and adoption of the subscription model.
kpis.signal: Sustained growth in the recurring model, key to the software transformation.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue remaining after deducting direct costs associated with production.
kpis.description: Gross margin continues to improve, rising from 82.2% in 2023 to 86.8% in 2025, driven by the shift to a pure software model.
kpis.signal: High gross margin typical of software vendors.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin improved from -11.1% in 2023 to +6.8% in 2025, marking a turning point in operational execution and cost discipline.
kpis.signal: Transition to operational profitability after prior losses.

kpis.name: R&D Investment as % of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: R&D expenses as a percentage of revenue have slightly increased, supported by initiatives such as Project Beacon and AI integration into the platform.
kpis.signal: Sustained investment in software innovation and AI.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from operations after capital expenditures.
kpis.description: FCF has grown significantly, rising from $207M in 2023 to $750M in 2025, driven by recurring revenue growth and operational efficiency gains.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement in cash generation linked to rising profitability.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by the company during the fiscal year.
kpis.description: Revenue increased from $1.86B in 2023 to $2.54B in 2025, with stable annual growth of approximately 15-18%, driven by ARR.
kpis.signal: Robust organic growth supported by the shift to a subscription model.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Headcount has remained stable around 4,500 employees, reflecting disciplined cost management and increasing employee productivity.
kpis.signal: Stable headcount despite revenue and cash flow growth, reflecting productivity gains.

kpis.name: Percentage of Deals Including AI Features
kpis.explanation: Percentage of new cloud contracts that include AI-related capabilities.
kpis.description: 40% of new deals in 2025 include AI features, up from 30% in 2024, indicating increasing AI integration into the Nutanix platform.
kpis.signal: Accelerating adoption of AI in customer deployments, a key growth momentum.

kpis.name: Total End Customers
kpis.explanation: Total number of end customers using the Nutanix platform.
kpis.description: Customer count increased from 24.6K in 2023 to 29.3K in 2025, driven by demand for hybrid infrastructure and the platform's AI capabilities.
kpis.signal: Solid and consistent customer base growth, demonstrating the appeal of the hybrid multicloud model.

ai_positioning.summary: Nutanix is actively integrating AI into its hybrid cloud platform, positioning AI as a lever for operational efficiency and application innovation for its customers. It does not develop pure AI models, but enables enterprise AI workloads (machine learning, generative AI, agentic AI) in distributed environments.
evidence: The Nutanix Cloud Platform supports enterprise AI workloads, including machine learning, generative AI, and agentic AI.
40% of new cloud deals include AI features in FY2025, up 10 points.
Project Beacon aims to deliver AI-centric data services via Kubernetes.
